verdict.rationale: Stripe exposes API endpoints for some Radar objects (reviews approve/list, value lists, early fraud warnings retrieval) but rules creation/editing, risk settings, and review-queue configuration are documented only as Dashboard features with no corresponding API endpoints in the evidence pack. A community report explicitly flags 'lack of easy programmatic control' for Radar rule behavior, corroborating that UI-only configuration paths exist. Missing for 10: documented API endpoints for creating/updating rules, risk settings, and review-queue criteria; independent confirmation that all UI actions have API parity.
